summary: Teaches connecting an AWS account to Grafana Cloud via CloudWatch scrape jobs using the Cloud provider app.

needs.description: AWS account with admin or IAM rights to launch the CloudFormation stack creating the Grafana role, and running tagged resources (EC2, RDS, Lambda).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: AWS account, resources with at least one tag

needs.description: Cloud Provider app (grafana-csp-app) with AWS section enabled.
Valid role ARN accepted by "Add account"; guide types a placeholder ARN (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:...) that real verification would reject.
CloudWatch metrics flowing so Services tab shows data-sent OK.

reviewNotes: Placeholder ARN means real E2E needs either a real AWS account or a pre-created account/scrape job on the stack; later milestones depend on them.
